name: youre-on-escrow-devnet
filter_function: <base64 of filter.js: npx tsx infra/quicknode/build-filter.ts --create-body https://<FLY_APP>.fly.dev>
notes: API-CONTRACT §5.1. Create with POST https://api.quicknode.com/streams/rest/v1/streams (header x-api-key) only after the hosted URL exists; build-filter.ts --create-body fills filter_function and url and drops this notes key.

The response's destination_attributes.security_token goes into the Fly secret QN_STREAM_SECURITY_TOKEN; the server verifies X-QN-Signature = hex HMAC-SHA256(token, X-QN-Nonce + X-QN-Timestamp + decompressed body), |now - ts| <= 300 s (apps/server/src/chain/quicknode.ts).
dataset_batch_size must be >= 5 (422 otherwise). filter_language is unverified (FINDINGS §6 step 4): validate with POST /streams/test_filter and --probe first.
Pause the Stream when idle (~11 M credits/day at 24/7, shared with the RPC).
